title_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Significance (Episode 69)
description_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Significance (Episode 69), an episode of the program Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An analytical review of the sources, narrators, and implications of Hadith al-Thaqalayn.
